settings.label: Model Role Storage
settings.description: Where model selector role assignments are saved

options.label: Global
options.description: Save role models in the active profile config (current behavior)

options.label: Per-project
options.description: Save project role models in .omp/config.yml; missing project roles use global defaults

settings.label: Enable Git Integration
settings.description: Show git branch, status, and PR information in the TUI and watch repository metadata.

settings.label: Auto-Resize Images
settings.description: Resize large images to 2000x2000 max for better model compatibility

settings.label: Block Images
settings.description: Prevent images from being sent to LLM providers

settings.label: Steering Mode
settings.description: How to process queued messages while agent is working

settings.label: Follow-Up Mode
settings.description: How to drain follow-up messages after a turn completes

settings.label: Interrupt Mode
settings.description: When steering messages interrupt tool execution

settings.label: Loop Mode
settings.description: What happens between /loop iterations before re-submitting the prompt

options.label: Prompt
options.description: Re-submit the prompt as a follow-up message (current behavior)

options.label: Compact
options.description: Compact the session context, then re-submit the prompt

options.label: Reset
options.description: Start a new session, then re-submit the prompt

settings.label: Loop Condition Timeout (ms)
settings.description: Max wait for a `/loop --while` / `--until` condition command before treating it as broken and stopping the loop. Set to 0 to wait indefinitely

settings.label: Bare Slash Commands
settings.description: Submitting exactly a command name without the leading `/` (e.g. `model`, `compact`) runs that slash command; once the session has messages, press Enter twice to confirm

settings.label: Magic Keywords
settings.description: Enable hidden notices for standalone ultrathink, orchestrate, workflowz, jevify keywords

settings.label: Ultrathink Keyword
settings.description: Let standalone ultrathink request maximum automatic thinking and append its hidden notice

settings.label: Orchestrate Keyword
settings.description: Let standalone orchestrate append its hidden multi-agent orchestration notice

settings.label: Workflow Keyword
settings.description: Let standalone workflowz append its hidden eval workflow notice

settings.label: Jevify Keyword
settings.description: Let standalone jevify append its hidden bulk-judge classification notice

settings.label: Ask Timeout
settings.description: Auto-select the recommended ask option after this many seconds (0 disables). Also bounds cfg:// approval prompts; an unanswered approval denies the write instead of auto-selecting

settings.label: Ask Notification
settings.description: Notify when the ask tool is waiting for input

settings.label: Idle Recap
settings.description: Generate a brief LLM recap of where things stand after the terminal has been idle

settings.label: Idle Recap Delay
settings.description: Seconds to wait while idle before showing the recap

settings.label: Resume Worktree Scope
settings.description: Choose whether the resume picker's current folder includes sessions from other repository worktrees

options.label: This Directory
options.description: Only sessions saved for this directory

options.label: Repository Worktrees
options.description: Also include sessions from sibling worktrees

settings.label: Sleep Prevention
settings.description: Prevent the system sleeping while the agent is running a turn; an idle session, including one waiting on background jobs, does not hold it. Each level is cumulative — it adds the flags of all lower levels.

options.label: Prevent Idle Sleep
options.description: Keep the system awake while the agent is running a turn (macOS `caffeinate -i`)

options.label: Prevent Display Sleep
options.description: Also keep the display from idle-sleeping (macOS `caffeinate -i -d`)

options.label: Prevent System Sleep
options.description: Also block all system sleep on AC and declare the user active (macOS `caffeinate -i -d -s -u`)

settings.label: Enable Prewalk
settings.description: Start on the active model, then switch to a fast/cheap model (default the 'smol' role) at the first edit/write after the plan nudge's todo list exists — the strong model plans, commits the todos, and starts the implementation before handing off. Overridable per session with --prewalk / --no-prewalk.

settings.label: Prewalk planning model
settings.description: Model or role (default '@default') that /prewalk restart returns to for planning.

settings.label: Prewalk target
settings.description: Model or role (default '@smol') that prewalk hands off to at the first edit/write: /prewalk, /prewalk restart, Enable Prewalk, and --prewalk. Auto-prewalk uses its own target.

settings.label: Auto Prewalk
settings.description: Ask the native judge resolved through the 'judge' role whether each new top-level user task front-loads its hard reasoning. Needs a native judge; without one nothing is classified. Independent of Enable Prewalk.

options.label: Suggest
options.description: Classify each task and report the decision without arming prewalk

options.label: On
options.description: For confidently front-loaded tasks, arm a handoff from the active model to the auto target; the next task starts back on the planning model

settings.label: Auto-prewalk target
settings.description: Model or role (default '@smol') auto-prewalk hands off to at the first edit/write.

settings.label: Describe Images for Text Models
settings.description: When an image is attached to a model without vision support, save it under local:// and inject a description from a vision-capable model instead of dropping it

settings.label: Thinking Level
settings.description: Reasoning depth for thinking-capable models

settings.label: Omit Thinking summaries
settings.description: Instruct upstream providers to completely omit thinking summaries from responses (where supported)

settings.label: External Thinking
settings.description: Private scratchpad; not shown to user. Disables supported GPT, Claude, and Gemini reasoning
settings.warning: At your own risk: providers have flagged this request shape as abuse, up to account-level enforcement

settings.label: Loop Guard
settings.description: Enable automatic stream loop detection for model reasoning and prose

settings.label: Loop Guard Scan Prose
settings.description: Apply loop guard to assistant prose messages in addition to thinking logs

settings.label: Loop Guard Tool-Call Reminder
settings.description: When a Gemini reasoning stream emits many consecutive planning headers without calling a tool, interrupt it and inject a reminder to issue a tool call (requires Loop Guard)

settings.label: Tool-Call Loop Guard
settings.description: Detect consecutive identical tool calls across turns and inject a corrective steer

settings.label: Tool-Call Loop Threshold
settings.description: Consecutive identical tool calls required before the corrective steer is injected

settings.label: Tool-Call Loop Exempt Tools
settings.description: Tool names that may repeat consecutively without triggering the cross-turn loop guard

settings.label: Inline Tool Descriptors
settings.description: Render full tool descriptors in the system prompt and strip top-level/nested descriptions from provider tool schemas so descriptor text is sent once. Auto enables this for Gemini models and disables it otherwise

options.label: Auto
options.description: Inline descriptors for Gemini models; keep them in tool schemas otherwise

options.label: On
options.description: Always inline descriptors in the system prompt

options.label: Off
options.description: Keep descriptors in provider tool schemas only

settings.label: Include Model in Prompt
settings.description: Surface the active model identifier in the system prompt so the agent knows which model it is

settings.label: Include Workspace Tree
settings.description: Render the workspace directory tree in the system prompt. WARNING: This can bust prompt caching across sessions when files are modified.

settings.label: List Skills in Prompt
settings.description: List available skills in the system prompt; disable to save context and toggle per-session with /skillful

settings.label: Personality
settings.description: Communication style rendered into the system prompt's personality block

options.label: Default
options.description: Terse, evidence-first engineer; dense, action-oriented replies

options.label: Friendly
options.description: Warm, encouraging collaborator focused on momentum and morale

options.label: Pragmatic
options.description: Direct, efficient engineer focused on clarity and rigor

settings.label: Temperature
settings.description: Sampling temperature (0 = deterministic, 1 = creative, -1 = provider default)

settings.label: Top P
settings.description: Nucleus sampling cutoff (0-1, -1 = provider default)

settings.label: Top K
settings.description: Sample from top-K tokens (-1 = provider default)

settings.label: Min P
settings.description: Minimum probability threshold (0-1, -1 = provider default)

settings.label: Presence Penalty
settings.description: Penalty for introducing already-present tokens (-1 = provider default)

settings.label: Repetition Penalty
settings.description: Penalty for repeated tokens (-1 = provider default)

settings.label: Text Verbosity
settings.description: OpenAI Responses and Codex response verbosity (low, medium, or high)

settings.label: Service Tier — OpenAI
settings.description: Processing tier for OpenAI / OpenAI-Codex requests, and OpenAI-family models routed via OpenRouter (none = omit). Sent as `service_tier`.

options.label: Flex
options.description: Lower cost, higher latency when available

options.label: Ultrafast
options.description: Lowest-latency serving; OpenAI API preview access, or Codex and relay models that advertise it

settings.label: Service Tier — Anthropic
settings.description: Processing tier for Claude requests. `priority` realizes fast mode (`speed: "fast"`) on supported direct Anthropic models; ignored on Bedrock/Vertex Claude and via OpenRouter.

options.label: Priority
options.description: Fast mode (`speed: "fast"`) on supported direct Claude models; ignored on Bedrock/Vertex

settings.label: Service Tier — Google
settings.description: Processing tier for Gemini (Google AI Studio + Vertex) requests, and Google-family models routed via OpenRouter (none = omit). Sent as the top-level `serviceTier` field.

options.label: Flex
options.description: Lower cost, higher latency (Gemini API + Vertex)

settings.label: Service Tier — Subagent
settings.description: Service Tier for spawned task/eval subagents. Inherit = match the main agent's live per-family tiers (tracks /fast); pick a value to apply it to whichever family the subagent's model belongs to.

options.label: Inherit
options.description: Match the main agent's live per-family tiers

options.label: Priority
options.description: Priority on every supported family of the spawned model

settings.label: Service Tier — Advisor
settings.description: Service Tier for the advisor model. None = standard processing; Inherit = match the main agent's live per-family tiers; pick a value to apply it to the advisor model's family.

options.label: Inherit
options.description: Match the main agent's live per-family tiers

options.label: Priority
options.description: Priority on every supported family of the spawned model

settings.label: Retry Attempts
settings.description: Maximum retry attempts on API errors

settings.label: Max Retry Delay
settings.description: Maximum wait between retries, in ms. When the provider asks us to wait longer than this and no credential or model fallback succeeds, the request fails fast instead of sleeping (e.g. 3-hour Anthropic rate-limit windows). 0 disables the ceiling — to let the session auto-resume through provider-stated quota resets.

settings.label: Wait For Usage Reset
settings.description: When a provider reports usage-limit exhaustion with a reset time (5-hour or weekly quota windows on any provider), sleep until the reset instead of failing fast past retry.maxDelayMs. Waits are abortable (Esc) but also hold subagents, so leave off for unattended runs.

settings.label: Retry Model Fallback
settings.description: Allow retry recovery to switch to models in retry.fallbackChains after provider errors. Independent of Auto-Promote Context

settings.label: Fallback Trigger
settings.description: Which failed requests may switch to a configured fallback model

options.label: Any error
options.description: Every provider error may switch models

options.label: Usage limits only
options.description: Switch only on a usage limit; retry other errors on the same model, then surface them

options.label: All but usage limits
options.description: Wait out or surface a usage limit; switch on other errors

settings.label: Rate Limit Walks Chain
settings.description: On a rate limit, do not hold the retry.fallbackChains walk for a turn whose thinking is signed by the failing model. Off (the default), such a turn keeps retrying the rate-limited model until retry.maxRetries is spent before the chain is reached.

settings.label: Usage-Aware Fallback
settings.description: Use reliable coding-plan quota reports to prefer same-provider accounts, then configured fallback models, before a hard usage limit. Ordinary configured API keys are excluded.

settings.label: Reserve Margin
settings.description: Treat a coding-plan model as near its limit below this remaining percentage. Unknown or unmapped usage keeps the primary model.

settings.label: Reserve Policy
settings.description: What to do when every same-provider coding-plan account is inside the reserve margin.

options.label: Confirm interactively
options.description: Keep interactive sessions on the primary until confirmed; background agents auto-fallback

options.label: Auto-fallback
options.description: Always select the next eligible configured fallback

options.label: Fail closed
options.description: Do not spend reserve quota or select a fallback

settings.label: Fallback Revert Policy
settings.description: When to return to the primary model after a fallback

options.label: Cooldown expiry
options.description: Return to the primary model after its suppression window ends

options.label: Never
options.description: Stay on the fallback model until manually changed

settings.label: Anthropic Server-Side Fallback (Fable 5)
settings.description: When a Claude Fable 5 / Mythos 5 request is blocked by Anthropic's safety classifier, retry it on Claude Opus 5 server-side (Anthropic `server-side-fallback-2026-06-01` beta). Opt-in — leaving this off preserves the pre-fallback behavior for every request.

settings.label: Ollama Cloud Max Concurrency
settings.description: Maximum concurrent Ollama Cloud subagent runs per process; 0 disables the provider-specific limit

settings.label: Web Search Timeout
settings.description: Hard timeout for each provider's search transport before web_search advances to the next fallback, in seconds (maximum 300)

settings.label: Antigravity Endpoint Mode
settings.description: Endpoint routing strategy for google-antigravity providers (chat, search, image, discovery)

options.label: Auto
options.description: Try production endpoint, fail over to sandbox on 5xx/429

settings.label: Fireworks Tier
settings.description: Serving path for Fireworks requests. Priority sends `service_tier: "priority"` for higher reliability during peak traffic at a higher price; Standard omits it. Fast (`-fast`) models ignore this — Fast is its own serving path.

options.label: Priority
options.description: Priority serving path: higher reliability, premium per-token pricing

settings.label: Tiny Model Device
settings.description: Inference backend for local tiny models (titles + memory): an ONNX execution provider, or `mlx` to download MLX weights and run them through mlx-lm on Apple silicon. Default uses CPU-only ONNX. The PI_TINY_DEVICE env var overrides this.

options.label: MLX
options.description: Apple silicon GPU via mlx-lm (Python subprocess; macOS arm64)

options.label: CoreML
options.description: Apple CoreML (opt-in; can fail to load)

options.label: Auto
options.description: Let ONNX Runtime choose a provider

settings.label: Tiny Model Precision
settings.description: ONNX quantization/precision for local tiny models. Default uses each model's shipped dtype (q4); lower precision is faster, higher is more faithful. Ignored by the MLX backend (its repos are pre-quantized 4-bit). The PI_TINY_DTYPE env var overrides this.

settings.label: Auto Thinking Ceiling
settings.description: Highest effort the `auto` classifier may resolve. `xhigh` keeps the classifier one tier below the top, so only an explicit `ultrathink` reaches `max`; `max` lets a turn the classifier judges exceptional bill the top tier on models that expose it.

options.label: max
options.description: Classifier may resolve max where the model supports it

settings.label: Unexpected Stops
settings.description: Automatically recover when the assistant stops without a visible message. Smart also classifies text-only stops with a small model.

options.label: Mechanical
options.description: Retry stops with no visible assistant message; tool calls are excluded (default)

options.label: Smart
options.description: Mechanical + small-model classification of text-only stops

settings.label: Kimi API Format
settings.description: API format for Kimi Code provider (auto follows live model metadata)

settings.label: OpenAI WebSockets
settings.description: Websocket policy for OpenAI Codex models (auto uses model defaults, on forces, off disables)

options.label: Off
options.description: Disable websockets for OpenAI Codex models

options.label: On
options.description: Force websockets for OpenAI Codex models

settings.label: OpenAI Live Steering
settings.description: Deliver messages typed while a GPT-6 response streams into that response over the Codex WebSocket, instead of waiting for the next tool boundary

settings.label: Muse Code Stored Responses
settings.description: Store Muse Code results on Meta's servers so a turn whose connection drops is recovered instead of re-run. Stored runs keep prompts and outputs on Meta's side.

settings.label: Codex Daybreak Blue
settings.description: Automatically request the Daybreak Blue cyber access program on ChatGPT accounts eligible for it. OpenAI may use content from Daybreak Blue sessions to improve its models. Does not cover dedicated Daybreak Blue models (gpt-daybreak-blue-*), which may still run as Daybreak sessions.

settings.label: Prompt Cache Retention
settings.description: Prompt-cache retention forwarded to providers that support it (Anthropic, Bedrock, OpenRouter, OpenAI)

options.label: Auto
options.description: Provider default — Anthropic OAuth subscriber sessions default to 1h, API keys use 5m; PI_CACHE_RETENTION still applies

options.label: Short (5m)
options.description: Cheapest cache writes; pair with cache warming to keep short entries alive while idle

options.label: Long (1h+)
options.description: Longer TTL where supported (Anthropic/Bedrock 1h, OpenAI GPT-5.6+ Responses 12h); pricier writes, only warmed during active runs

options.label: Off
options.description: Disable prompt caching and cache-affinity routing

settings.label: Cache Warming
settings.description: Re-send the last request with a one-token output budget shortly before its prompt-cache entry expires

options.label: Streaming
options.description: Protect expensive prefixes during long tool executions; stops when the agent settles

options.label: Idle
options.description: Also refresh 5-minute entries between runs while the expected savings stay above the cost floor

settings.label: Stream First Event Timeout
settings.description: Seconds to wait for the first model stream event; -1 uses provider/env defaults, 0 disables the watchdog

options.label: Auto
options.description: Use provider defaults and PI_* timeout env vars

settings.label: Stream Idle Timeout
settings.description: Seconds a model stream may stay silent between events; -1 uses provider/env defaults, 0 disables the watchdog

options.label: Auto
options.description: Use provider defaults and PI_* timeout env vars

settings.label: OpenRouter Routing
settings.description: Default routing-variant suffix appended to OpenRouter model IDs (overridden when the selector already names a variant)

options.label: Default
options.description: No suffix; use OpenRouter's default routing

options.label: :exacto
options.description: Cherry-picked high-quality providers (only defined for select models)

settings.label: Fetch Provider
settings.description: Reader backend priority for the fetch/read URL tool

options.label: Auto
options.description: Priority: native > trafilatura > lynx > parallel > firecrawl > jina

settings.label: Codex Auto-Redeem Saved Resets
settings.description: Spend saved Codex rate-limit resets automatically: restore an account blocked by an exhausted 5h or weekly window when a turn is stuck and no other account can take over, and salvage credits that are about to expire. unset asks before the first spend (with no prompt UI, it spends only a reset expiring within 5 minutes), yes spends without prompting, and no disables both checks.

options.label: Unset
options.description: Check eligibility, then ask before spending the first saved reset. With no prompt UI, spend only a reset expiring within 5 minutes.

options.label: Yes
options.description: Spend eligible saved resets without prompting.

options.label: No
options.description: Do not run the saved-reset auto-redeem check.

settings.label: Codex Auto-Redeem Min Block
settings.description: Only auto-redeem when the natural unblock — the latest reset among the exhausted 5h/weekly windows — is at least this many minutes away (don't spend a scarce credit to save a short wait). Raise it (e.g. 360) to ignore 5h-only blocks.

settings.label: Codex Auto-Redeem Reserve
settings.description: Never auto-spend below this many saved resets (0 = the last credit may be spent automatically). Credits about to expire are exempt — a reserved credit that expires preserves nothing.

settings.label: Codex Reset Salvage Horizon
settings.description: With auto-redeem enabled, spend a saved Codex reset within this many hours of expiry when either chat window has meaningful usage. 0 disables early salvage; credits expiring within 5 minutes are still attempted regardless of usage.

settings.label: Claude Auto-Redeem Resets
settings.description: Spend eligible Claude Cedar or Juniper resets automatically. Cedar is spent only for covered limits; Juniper can only recover a sole 5-hour block. unset asks before the first spend (with no prompt UI, it spends only a reset expiring within 5 minutes), yes spends without prompting, and no disables blocked recovery and expiry salvage.

options.label: Unset
options.description: Check live eligibility, then ask before spending the first Claude reset. With no prompt UI, spend only a reset expiring within 5 minutes.

options.label: Yes
options.description: Spend eligible Claude resets without prompting.

options.label: No
options.description: Do not run Claude reset auto-redeem checks.

settings.label: Claude Auto-Redeem Min Block
settings.description: Only auto-redeem when the natural unblock — the latest reset among the exhausted covered windows — is at least this many minutes away. A 5-hour-only reset is never used for a weekly or model-scoped block.

settings.label: Claude Auto-Redeem Reserve
settings.description: Keep at least this many Claude resets banked (0 allows the last eligible reset to be spent automatically). The reserve applies to early salvage, but not to eligible resets expiring within 5 minutes.

settings.label: Claude Reset Salvage Horizon
settings.description: With auto-redeem enabled, use a server-selected Cedar reset within this many hours of expiry when its covered windows have meaningful usage. 0 disables early salvage; eligible Cedar or Juniper resets expiring within 5 minutes are still attempted regardless of usage or reserve. Provider limit requirements still apply.

settings.label: Append-Only Context
settings.description: Cache system prompt + tool specs and keep an append-only message log so provider prefix caches (DeepSeek, Xiaomi/SGLang, Anthropic) hit at maximum rate. Auto enables for known prefix-cache providers.

settings.label: OTLP Telemetry Export
settings.description: Allow OMP to export traces, logs, and metrics using OTEL_* endpoints. Changes take effect on the next launch.

settings.label: Enable Advisor
settings.description: Pair a second model (assigned to the 'advisor' role) that passively reviews each turn and injects notes.

settings.label: Advisor Sync Backlog
settings.description: Pause main agent until advisor backlog falls below threshold. Numeric values cap wait at 30 seconds; strict waits for all scheduled reviews without a wall-clock cap. Off disables catch-up delays. Abort, failure, and disposal release waits.

settings.label: Advisor Immune Turns
settings.description: After an advisor concern or blocker interrupts, route further concerns as non-interrupting asides for this many primary turns. Blockers are exempt from the cooldown.

settings.label: Advisor Continue Severity
settings.description: Minimum severity of an advisor note that wakes the agent after it finished with a final answer. Lower-severity notes stay as a card at the end of the transcript and reach the agent with your next message.

options.label: Concern
options.description: Concerns and blockers continue the run. Default.

settings.label: Advisor Review Mode
settings.description: Default advisor cadence when no WATCHDOG.yml roster is present. turn reviews every primary turn; agent-end reviews only final yields.

options.label: Agent end
options.description: Review only at final yields (once per run).

settings.label: Advisor Review Interval
settings.description: Default advisor cadence when no WATCHDOG.yml roster is present: review every Nth eligible primary update. 1 = every update. Skipped updates are sent with the next scheduled review.

settings.label: Advisor Max Notes Per Update
settings.description: Maximum non-blocker advice notes accepted per advisor prompt update (1–32; UI offers 1–5 quick picks). Blockers are exempt.

settings.label: Advisor Evict Stale Results
settings.description: Before each review, replace the advisor's read/grep/glob output from older reviews with a short placeholder. The latest review is kept.

settings.label: Additional Workspace Dirs
settings.description: Extra workspace directories added to every session as additional roots (multi-root workspace). Managed live via /add-dir and /remove-dir. Paths resolve relative to cwd; absolute paths recommended. The agent is told these roots exist and can read/grep/glob them.

settings.label: Extra Context Files
settings.description: Extra instruction filenames loaded beside AGENTS.md. Use a JSON list of names, not paths, e.g. ["AGENTS.local.md"]; [] disables extras. Start a new session to load them.

settings.label: Auto-Promote Context
settings.description: Promote to the model's contextPromotionTarget on context overflow instead of compacting. Retry fallback switches are controlled by Retry Model Fallback

settings.label: Extended Context
settings.description: Use larger context windows where supported; may incur premium pricing. Off keeps default or standard-pricing windows

settings.label: Auto-Compact
settings.description: Automatically compact context when it gets too large

settings.label: Notes-backed context windows (experimental)
settings.description: Keep persistent notes and searchable raw history across context windows.

settings.label: Mid-Turn Compaction
settings.description: Check thresholds at safe mid-turn tool-loop boundaries before the next provider request; subagents always check, since their whole assignment is one turn

settings.label: Compaction Method Order
settings.description: Preferred fallback order for automatic context maintenance; unavailable or failed methods advance to the next choice

options.label: Server compaction
options.description: Use provider-native server compaction (OpenAI Responses compact, Anthropic compaction beta, including on Bedrock) when the active route supports it

options.label: Snapcompact
options.description: Archive history onto dense bitmap images the active vision model reads back; no LLM call

options.label: Handoff
options.description: Generate a handoff document and continue from it as the compaction summary

options.label: Soft compaction
options.description: Summarize in place with a compaction model without using server compaction

options.label: Shake
options.description: Drop recoverable heavy content in place without an LLM call

settings.label: Compaction Threshold
settings.description: Percent threshold for context maintenance; set to Default to use legacy reserve-based behavior

settings.label: Compaction Token Limit
settings.description: Fixed token limit for context maintenance; overrides percentage if set

settings.label: Save Handoff Docs
settings.description: Save generated handoff documents to markdown files for the auto-handoff flow

settings.label: Remote Compaction V2
settings.description: Use Responses streaming compaction for compatible remote compaction models

settings.label: Async Compaction
settings.description: Speculatively summarize in the background as context nears the compaction threshold, then splice the ready result in when the threshold is crossed

settings.label: Idle Compaction
settings.description: Compact context while idle when token count exceeds threshold

settings.label: Idle Compaction Threshold
settings.description: Token count above which idle compaction triggers

settings.label: Idle Compaction Delay
settings.description: Seconds to wait while idle before compacting; with a 1-hour prompt cache, compaction instead runs just before the cache expires

settings.label: Supersede Stale Reads
settings.description: Prune older read results when the same file is read again (cache-aware, runs every turn)

settings.label: Elide Uneventful Results
settings.description: Prune tool results flagged contextually useless (no matches, timed-out waits) once consumed (cache-aware)

settings.label: Snapcompact System Prompt
settings.description: Experimental: render selected system prompt text as dense PNG image(s) and attach to the first user message (vision models only). Saves tokens; loses prompt caching for imaged text.

options.label: None
options.description: Keep the system prompt as text.

options.label: AGENTS.md
options.description: Only move loaded context-file instructions to images, when that saves tokens.

options.label: All
options.description: Move the full system prompt to images, when that saves tokens.

settings.label: Snapcompact Tool Results
settings.description: Experimental: render large tool results, the newest one included, as dense PNG image(s) instead of text (vision models only). Saves tokens on accumulated search and command output; read results stay text unless the model is known to edit exactly from images.

settings.label: Tool Calling Mode
settings.description: Controls how tools are exposed to the model. Auto uses provider-native tool calls unless the selected model is marked as not supporting them, then falls back to the GLM owned dialect. Native forces provider-native tools; the other values force the named owned dialect.

options.label: Auto
options.description: Use native tool calls unless the model is known not to support them.

options.label: XML
options.description: Use generic XML in-band tool calls.

settings.label: Snapcompact Shape
settings.description: Frame shape snapcompact prints text with (compaction archive and inline imaging). Auto picks a shape tuned for the current model.

options.label: Auto
options.description: Picks a shape tuned for the current model, falling back to its provider family.

options.label: 8x8 repeated, black
options.description: unscii square cell, black ink, every line printed twice with the copy on a pale highlight band.

options.label: 8x8 repeated, sentence hues
options.description: Repeated grid with ink cycling six hues at sentence boundaries.

options.label: 8x8, black
options.description: Plain unscii square cell, single-printed lines, black ink.

options.label: 8x8, sentence hues
options.description: Plain unscii square cell with sentence-hue ink.

options.label: 6x6 dense, black
options.description: unscii squeezed to 6x6 — densest readable cell, fewest frames — in black ink.

options.label: 5x8 legacy, black
options.description: Original X.org 5x8 glyphs on the 2576px frame, black ink.

options.label: 5x8 legacy, sentence hues

settings.label: Output Column Cap
settings.description: Per-line byte cap for streaming tool outputs (bash, python, js eval) and `read`. Lines wider than this are ellipsis-truncated; remaining bytes up to the next newline are dropped. 0 disables.

settings.label: Artifact Tail Lines
settings.description: Maximum lines of tail content kept inline when output spills to artifact

settings.label: Artifact File Cap (MB)
settings.description: Maximum size of the artifact file saved for streaming tool output (bash, python, js eval). Larger output keeps its beginning (up to 3 MB) and its most recent remainder, with a truncation notice between them. 0 = unlimited.

settings.label: Line Numbers

settings.label: Prose Summaries

settings.description: BFS-unfold elidable spans until the summary is at least this many visible lines. 0 keeps only the outermost elisions.

settings.label: Read Summary Unfold Ceiling

settings.label: Inline Read Previews

settings.label: Tool Approval
settings.description: Default approval behavior for tool calls. 'Always ask' auto-approves read-only tools only. 'Ask and remember' also asks before file reads, and can remember a file or folder. 'Write' auto-approves read and workspace-write tools. 'Yolo' auto-approves all tiers; user policy may still prompt or block.

options.label: Always ask

options.label: Write
options.description: Auto-approve read-only and write tools; require confirmation for exec tools such as bash, eval, browser, and task.

options.label: Yolo
options.description: Auto-approve read, write, and exec tools. User policy can still require confirmation or block calls.

settings.label: Restricted Folders
settings.description: Folders where every read, write, edit, search, or command needs an explicit approval, whatever the approval mode or a remembered grant. The folder and everything under it is restricted; commands are matched by the directory they run in. A JSON list of paths, e.g. ["~/secrets"].

options.label: Refuse

settings.label: Read URLs

settings.description: Enable the vault:// internal URL for reading and editing Obsidian vault content via the Obsidian CLI. When disabled, vault:// resolution is refused and the vault:// entry is omitted from the system prompt.

settings.description: Within this window, cached issue/PR view rows are returned directly (seconds; default 5 minutes)

settings.description: Past the soft TTL the cached row is returned and refreshed in the background; past the hard TTL it is dropped (seconds; default 7 days)

settings.label: Intent Tracing
settings.description: Ask the agent to describe the intent of each tool call before executing it

settings.label: Abort On Fabricated Tool Result
settings.description: With in-band tool calls, stop the model immediately when it starts hallucinating a tool result mid-turn. Disable to let the model finish generating and discard the fabricated continuation instead.

settings.label: Experimental Speculative Execution
settings.description: Enable the discard-safe first slice: validated local reads through direct read calls and nested eval. Network requests, provider completions, and live filesystem writes are not part of this baseline.

settings.label: Speculative Execution Concurrency
settings.description: Maximum number of validated local reads allowed to run before normal dispatch.

settings.label: Max Tool Timeout
settings.description: Maximum timeout in seconds the agent can set for any tool (0 = no limit)

settings.label: Async Execution
settings.description: Enable async bash commands and background task execution

settings.label: Wake Print Mode on Job Results
settings.description: In print mode (-p, --mode json), keep running after the last prompt while this run's background jobs are active, and start another turn in the same session with each job's result; exits once no job or result is pending. Off: print mode exits after its prompts and cancels running jobs

settings.label: xd:// Tools
settings.description: Mount rarely-used (discoverable) tools under xd:// device URLs driven via read/write instead of shipping their schemas on every request. Sessions whose explicit tool list grants read but omits write mount devices through a device-only write transport (only local:// scratch stays writable besides devices). Disable to expose every enabled tool top-level.

settings.label: xd:// Prompt Docs

options.label: Built-ins Only

options.label: Catalog Only

settings.label: xd:// Inline Devices
settings.description: When xd:// Prompt Docs is Built-ins Only, inline dynamic devices whose names match these glob patterns (for example mcp__context_mode_*). Catalog Only ignores this setting.

settings.label: xd:// Mount Notices
settings.description: Show an `xd://: mounted …` notice when MCP or extension tools are mounted or unmounted. The model still learns of the change with its next prompt.

settings.label: Auto QA Push Endpoint

While another omp instance in the project is running, a released server stays warm and the next connection reuses it instead of cold-starting (falls back to private servers when unavailable)

settings.label: Format on Write
settings.description: Automatically format code files using LSP after writing

settings.label: Diagnostics on Write
settings.description: Return LSP diagnostics after writing code files

settings.label: Diagnostics on Edit
settings.description: Return LSP diagnostics after editing code files

settings.label: Deduplicate Diagnostics
settings.description: Suppress post-edit LSP diagnostics already shown for a file; only surface new or changed ones

Raise it for servers that are slow on a cold start. The lsp tool's timeout argument can still raise or lower it per call

settings.label: Allow Compound Commands

settings.label: Bash Auto-Background

settings.label: Git Guard
settings.description: Refuse git commands that discard or move shared work in a repository's main checkout: stash, reset --hard or to another commit, and checkout/switch/restore outside a merge or rebase conflict. In a linked worktree they run, saving uncommitted changes they discard first

settings.label: Bash Approval Patterns
settings.description: Ordered bash command approval rules. Each item has match and approval fields; only '*' wildcards are supported.

settings.label: Bash Interceptor
settings.description: Block shell commands that have dedicated tools

settings.label: direnv Auto-Load
settings.description: Auto-load a repo's direnv/devenv `.envrc` into the bash session so devenv tools and env vars are present without manual `direnv exec`. Honors direnv's allow list: an `.envrc` you haven't `direnv allow`ed is never executed

settings.label: direnv Load Timeout (ms)
settings.description: Max wait for the first `direnv export` (a cold devenv shell can be slow); on timeout the session runs without the direnv env

settings.label: Shell Minimizer
settings.description: Compress verbose shell output (git, npm, cargo, etc.) before returning it to the agent

settings.label: Shell Minimizer Source Outline
settings.description: Source outline mode for cat/read of source files: default or aggressive

settings.label: Python Eval Backend

settings.label: JavaScript Eval Backend
settings.description: Allow the eval tool to dispatch JavaScript cells to the in-process runtime

settings.label: Eval Environment Provisioning

settings.label: Eval-Defined Tools
settings.description: Let eval cells define tools (@tool in Python, tool(fn) in JS) that task, agent(), and workpool() subagents can call

settings.label: Fresh Workpool Agents
settings.description: Spawn a new subagent for every workpool item instead of reusing workers or batching queued items

settings.label: Eval Auto-Background
settings.description: Automatically background long-running eval cells and deliver the result later

settings.label: Python Kernel Mode
settings.description: Keep the IPython kernel alive across eval calls or start fresh each time

settings.label: Python Interpreter
settings.description: Optional path to an exact Python executable. When set, automatic Python runtime discovery is skipped.

settings.label: Allow Isolated Subagents
settings.description: Allow per-task isolation with `isolated: true`; tasks without it run in the shared checkout

settings.label: Isolation Backend
settings.description: Backend used for subagent isolation and worktree cloning

options.label: Auto
options.description: Let the PAL pick the best available backend

options.label: Recursive copy
options.description: git worktree if available, otherwise recursive copy

settings.label: Clone Checkout into Worktrees
settings.description: New worktrees from `github pr_checkout` and `git worktree add` in bash start as a copy-on-write clone of the current checkout so ignored build artifacts (node_modules, target) carry over; falls back to a plain checkout when the filesystem cannot clone

settings.label: Clean Source Checkout on /wt
settings.description: When creating a worktree with `/wt`, reset tracked changes and remove untracked files from the original checkout after carrying them over

settings.label: Worktree on Start
settings.description: Whether fresh interactive sessions start in a new linked worktree

options.label: Create
options.description: Always start in a new worktree on a `wt/*` branch

settings.label: Worktree on Exit
settings.description: What to do on exit with worktrees created since omp started (on start or with `/wt`)

options.label: Remove
options.description: Remove clean worktrees; ask when they have uncommitted changes or new commits. Gitignored files (e.g. `.env`) are deleted too

settings.label: Apply Isolated Changes
settings.description: Automatically apply successful isolated task changes to the parent checkout; disable to retain patch or branch artifacts

settings.label: Isolation Merge Strategy
settings.description: How isolated task changes are integrated (patch apply or branch merge)

settings.label: Isolation Commit Style
settings.description: Commit message style for nested repo changes (generic or AI-generated)

settings.label: Worktree Base Directory
settings.description: Base directory for agent-managed worktrees — task-isolation copies, `github` PR checkouts, and `omp worktree` cleanup all live here. Unset uses ~/.omp/wt. Must be an absolute or ~-relative path; relative paths are ignored. The OMP_WORKTREE_DIR env var overrides this.

settings.label: Prefer Task Delegation
settings.description: How strongly to push delegating work to subagents

options.label: Default
options.description: Uses the selected model's policy; some models require an explicit delegation request

options.label: Preferred
options.description: Adds delegation guidance to the system prompt

options.label: Always
options.description: Prompt guidance plus a first-turn delegation reminder

settings.label: Batch Task Calls
settings.description: Switch the task tool to its batch shape: one call carries { context, tasks[] } — one subagent per item, with an optional per-item agent (defaulting to the session spawn-policy agent), per-item isolation, and a required shared context prepended to every assignment. With async.enabled=true, each spawn runs as an independent background agent with the normal idle/parked lifecycle; otherwise the call blocks for merged results. Disable to restore the flat single-spawn schema.

settings.label: Task Instructions from Files
settings.description: Let the task tool read subagent instructions from a file (taskFile), recording its path and SHA-256.

settings.label: Structured Task Results
settings.description: Expose outputSchema/schemaMode on the task tool and return subagent results through the yield tool, validated against caller or agent output schemas. Off: task subagents have no yield tool and return their final message as plain text, except agents whose definition sets structured: true. Eval agent()/workpool spawns always keep structured results.

settings.label: Speculative Task Launch
settings.description: Start each batch subagent as soon as its tasks[] item finishes streaming instead of waiting for the whole task call. Launched agents are aborted if the finished call fails validation, is blocked, or its arguments change. Requires auto-allowed task approval and no extension tool lifecycle handlers.

settings.label: Per-Task Effort
settings.description: Expose the optional effort parameter on task spawns, allowing callers to override each subagent's thinking level

settings.label: Per-Call Model
settings.description: Whether a subagent call may pick its model with one exact provider/model-id[@upstream][:level] selector. An @upstream pin is part of the model identity and is supported only by aggregators. Only models the configuration already routes to are accepted. Project settings can turn it off but not on, and never approve a model.

options.label: Off
options.description: Reject `model` on task items and eval agent()/workpool()

options.label: Eval only
options.description: Accept `model` in eval agent() and workpool() only

options.label: On
options.description: Accept `model` on task items and in eval agent()/workpool()

settings.label: Per-Call Model Allowlist
settings.description: Exact selectors: `provider/model-id`, including `@upstream` only for a pinned OpenRouter/Vercel route (e.g. `openrouter/x@y`). When set, a per-call model must also be listed here. Empty: every model the configuration grants. A project list can only narrow this one.

settings.label: Max Concurrent Tasks
settings.description: Maximum number of subagents running concurrently

settings.label: LSP in Subagents
settings.description: Allow subagents spawned via the task tool to use the lsp tool. Off by default to keep subagents cheap; enable when LSP-aware delegation is worth the extra tokens.

settings.label: Max Task Recursion
settings.description: How many levels deep subagents can spawn their own subagents

settings.label: Max Subagent Runtime
settings.description: Hard wall-clock limit per subagent (ms). 0 disables it. Defense-in-depth against provider-side stream hangs that escape the inference-layer watchdog; triggers a normal subagent abort with a 'timed out' reason.

settings.label: Subagent Completion Probe
settings.description: Ask a working subagent, through a cached side request like /btw, to estimate how complete its task is: after 2, 5, 10 and 30 more minutes, then hourly. The estimate shows next to the subagent in wait and task views. Only subagents spawned by the main agent of an interactive session are asked; print, RPC, ACP and SDK runs never probe.

settings.label: Agent Idle TTL
settings.description: How long an idle subagent stays live in memory before being parked to disk (ms). Parked agents are revived automatically when messaged or resumed. 0 keeps idle agents live until exit.

settings.label: Soft Subagent Request Budget
settings.description: Soft per-subagent request budget (assistant requests per run). Crossing it injects a wrap-up steering notice (see task.softRequestBudgetNotice); at 1.5x the budget the run is force-stopped and the agent must hand back its partial findings. 0 disables the guard. Bundled scout/sonic agents cap out at a lower built-in budget, so a value below that cap still applies to them. A task.agentSoftRequestBudget entry replaces this budget for the agent it names.

settings.label: Soft Request Budget Notice
settings.description: Inject one steering notice when a subagent crosses its soft request budget, asking it to wrap up before the 1.5x forced-yield stop.

settings.label: Maximum Per-Spawn Effort
settings.description: Maximum reasoning effort allowed for the task tool's per-spawn effort hint or a per-call model. An explicit `:level` is clamped to the highest supported effort at or below this ceiling, and an omitted `:level` inherits the agent's thinking level capped at this value; cold revival re-applies the cap. Unset, `:inherit` and `:off` keep their existing meaning. A per-call model must support an effort at or below this ceiling; the default preserves the model's full range.

settings.label: Generic Task Prewalk
settings.description: Arm prewalk for the bundled generic `task` subagent: it starts on its resolved model, plans and begins the implementation, then hands off to the 'smol' role at its first edit/write. Per-agent overrides (task.agentPrewalk, configured from the /agents hub) and user agent `prewalk` frontmatter apply regardless of this toggle.

settings.label: Plan Mode
settings.description: Enable plan mode for read-only exploration and planning before execution

settings.label: Start in Plan Mode
settings.description: Automatically enter plan mode at the start of every new session

settings.label: Autosave Plans
settings.description: Automatically save approved plans to disk when plan mode completes

settings.label: Autosave Directory
settings.description: Directory for autosaved plans. Supports ~, absolute, and cwd-relative paths. Empty uses <project>/.omp/plans/.

settings.label: Goal Mode
settings.description: Enable per-session goal mode and the hidden goal tool

settings.label: Goal Continuation Modes
settings.description: Run modes where active goals may auto-continue between turns ("interactive", "rpc")

settings.label: Title Generator
settings.description: What names an untitled session from the user's messages

options.label: Fork
options.description: A side turn of the reply on the session's model: reads its prompt cache, adds the card icon (default)

options.label: Tiny
options.description: The title model role only; plain titles without a card

settings.label: Refresh Title on Replan
settings.description: Refresh generated session titles after todo init replans unless the title was set by the user

settings.label: Refresh Title After Prompts
settings.description: Every this many operator prompts, ask the judge model whether a generated session title still fits the conversation, and regenerate it if not

settings.label: Skill Registry
settings.description: Skillshare registry used by `omp skill` to install, search, and publish skills (https://host[:port])

settings.label: Skill Commands
settings.description: Register skills as /skill:name commands

settings.label: Claude User Commands
settings.description: Load commands from ~/.claude/commands/

settings.label: Claude Project Commands
settings.description: Load commands from .claude/commands/

settings.label: OpenCode User Commands
settings.description: Load commands from ~/.config/opencode/commands/

settings.label: OpenCode Project Commands
settings.description: Load commands from .opencode/commands/

settings.label: Tool Call Handler Timeout (ms)
settings.description: Positive finite active-work timeout for extension tool_call handlers; invalid values use 30000ms, and time awaiting OMP-owned dialogs does not count

settings.label: Extension Mode Control
settings.description: Let extensions enter and exit plan, vibe, goal, and loop modes via ctx.sessionModes.set(); reading mode state stays available

settings.label: Exa
settings.description: Enable the Exa web search provider

settings.label: Exa Search Delay
settings.description: Minimum delay between Exa web search requests in milliseconds; set 0 to disable pacing

settings.label: SearXNG Endpoint
settings.description: Base URL of a self-hosted SearXNG instance used for web search

settings.label: Browser
settings.description: Enable the browser eval prelude for scripted Chromium automation (Puppeteer)

settings.label: Browser CDP URL
settings.description: Default HTTP CDP discovery endpoint (for example http://127.0.0.1:9222) to attach to instead of launching a browser. Explicit app.cdp_url or app.path on the tool call take precedence.

settings.label: Browser Relay
settings.description: Drive your own Chrome tabs through the omp browser relay. Install the extension once (`omp browser-relay install`); the relay server auto-starts when the browser prelude needs it. Takes precedence over Browser CDP URL; set PI_BROWSER_RELAY=0 or PI_BROWSER_RELAY=1 to override.

settings.label: Browser Relay URL
settings.description: omp browser relay endpoint (default http://127.0.0.1:9224).

settings.label: Headless Browser
settings.description: Launch browser in headless mode (disable to show browser UI)

settings.label: cmux Browser
settings.description: Use cmux WKWebView surfaces for browser automation when a cmux socket is available. Set PI_BROWSER_CMUX=0 or PI_BROWSER_CMUX=1 to override.

settings.label: Tern Browser
settings.description: Inside a Tern pane, open browser tabs as picture-in-pictures over omp's pane (native web view) instead of headless Chromium; falls back to Chromium when no Tern window can host them. Explicit app options, the relay and Browser CDP URL take precedence; app.tern:false opts one open out. Set PI_BROWSER_TERN=0 or PI_BROWSER_TERN=1 to override.

settings.label: Freeze Browser Tabs On Turn End
settings.description: Freeze OMP-owned headless browser tabs when a turn settles so animated pages stop burning CPU/GPU while idle. Tabs unfreeze automatically on next use; pass persist:true on open to opt a tab out.

settings.label: Browser Idle Close Timeout
settings.description: Close OMP-owned headless browser tabs and Tern browser picture-in-pictures idle longer than this many seconds (0 = never; session dispose still reaps). Never touches relay/CDP/spawned browsers or other sessions' tabs.

settings.label: Screenshot Directory
settings.description: Directory to save screenshots. If unset, screenshots go to a temp file. Supports ~. Examples: ~/Downloads, ~/Desktop, /sdcard/Download (Android)

settings.label: IDA Pro
settings.description: Open executables read with `read` in IDA Pro (idalib) and enable the `ida` tool; inert when no IDA install is found

settings.label: IDA Python
settings.description: Python interpreter that can import ida_domain and idapro; empty auto-detects

settings.label: IDA Install Dir
settings.description: Directory containing libidalib, exported as IDADIR; empty auto-detects ($IDADIR, ida-config.json, standard install paths)

settings.label: IDA Max Open Databases
settings.description: Most IDA databases (omp.ida.* daemons in omp ps) open at once per project; opening another saves and closes the least recently used idle one

settings.label: IDA Idle Close Timeout
settings.description: Save and close IDA databases idle longer than this many seconds (0 = never); the exec namespace resets on reopen

settings.label: MCP Project Config
settings.description: Load .mcp.json/mcp.json from project root

settings.label: MCP Startup Window
settings.description: Wait this many milliseconds for initial MCP tool discovery; 0 waits until connections settle

settings.label: MCP Markdown Results
settings.description: Render non-JSON MCP text results as Markdown in the transcript

settings.label: MCP Update Injection
settings.description: Inject MCP resource updates into the agent conversation

settings.label: MCP Notification Debounce
settings.description: Debounce window in milliseconds for MCP resource updates before injecting them into the conversation

settings.label: Serve Images as URLs
settings.description: Publish outgoing images through the configured backend chain and send URL-fetching providers short URLs instead of inline base64. Falls back to inline automatically when every backend or a provider fetch fails

settings.label: Image URL Backends
settings.description: Ordered destinations tried when publishing images for provider access

options.label: Imgur
options.description: Uploads require either an Imgur access token or client ID.

options.label: ImageShack
options.description: The API requires a paid subscription.

options.label: puush-compatible endpoint

options.label: Backblaze B2
options.description: Configure either native B2 application keys or S3-compatible access keys.

options.label: MediaFire-compatible endpoint
options.description: The public API is deprecated; a replacement endpoint is required.

options.label: SendSpace-compatible endpoint
options.description: The public discovery API is deprecated; a replacement endpoint is required.

options.label: Hostr-compatible endpoint
options.description: The public service is offline; a replacement endpoint is required.

options.label: Lambda-compatible endpoint
options.description: The public service is offline; a replacement endpoint is required.

options.label: Uguu
options.description: Public uploads expire after approximately three hours.

options.label: LobFile-compatible endpoint
options.description: The public service is offline; a replacement endpoint is required.

options.label: transfer.sh-compatible endpoint
options.description: The defunct public endpoint is blocked; a self-hosted replacement is required.

options.label: 0x0.st
options.description: Public uploads expire after a retention window determined by file size.

options.label: Model provider files
options.description: Provider file references are API-local rather than public image URLs.

options.label: Microsoft dev tunnel
options.description: The devtunnel CLI must be logged in locally.

options.label: zrok
options.description: The local zrok environment must be enabled.

settings.label: Image Upload Command
settings.description: Argv template for the command backend; {file} is the image path, {mime}/{ext} optional. The last URL printed on stdout is used (e.g. pasta -b -f {file})

settings.label: Image URL Public Base
settings.description: Externally reachable base URL fronting the blob server (required for ssh, optional for direct)

settings.label: Image URL Lifetime (hours)
settings.description: Serving window for locally hosted image URLs, measured from the last time a conversation sent them; resuming a conversation re-arms the window at the same link. 0 keeps links alive while the broker runs

settings.label: Image URL Bind Host
settings.description: Host the blob server binds to; loopback for tunnels, 0.0.0.0 for direct serving

settings.label: Image URL SSH Target
settings.description: user@host destination for the ssh reverse forward

settings.label: Image URL SSH Remote Port
settings.description: Remote listen port of the ssh reverse forward that your web server proxies to

settings.label: Hide Secrets
settings.description: Obfuscate configured secrets and redact credential-shaped tokens before sending to AI providers
